lines: I can't let this be the end
of me... I'll avenge this defeat!
Damn! It can't end here. I'll
settle this score!
Damn it! Still... I won't let this
defeat go to waste!
They got me... Just you wait!
Like hell I'll die here! I'll pay
you back for this!
Blast it! It can't end like this!
I'll settle this score yet!
I won't let it end here! I'll teach
you a lesson!
I'll avenge our commander!
Our commander's last wishes... I'll
carry them out myself!
I'll make them pay for what they
did to our commander!
I'll see our commander avenged!
I'll avenge our commander myself!
I'll see to it myself. Our
commander will be avenged!
I shall see our commander avenged!
Well, I'm in a difficult position.
What am I to do now?
Am I just going to waste away...?
No. There must be a place for me.
Aw, we lost. I'd better find
someone else to work for, and fast.
Well, that puts me in a tough spot.
What am I supposed to do now...?
Tch. I'll go hungry at this rate.
Now what...?
Hmm... Isn't there someone out
there who could use me?
Well, this is a bind. I'll have
to consider my next move.

catalogue.substitutions: No runtime substitutions in these three original tables.

2690.english: I can't let this be the end of me... I'll avenge this defeat!
2690.localization_note: Keep the personal resolve and place the vow together after the pause.

2695.english: Blast it! It can't end like this! I'll settle this score yet!
2695.localization_note: Give the seasoned speaker a distinct curse and keep the whole final vow together.

2698.english: Our commander's last wishes... I'll carry them out myself!
2698.localization_note: Keep the speaker’s personal promise and place “last wishes” together.

2704.english: Well, I'm in a difficult position. What am I to do now?
2704.localization_note: Give the measured admission and uncertain question their own turns in the paragraph.

2705.english: Am I just going to waste away...? No. There must be a place for me.
2705.localization_note: Preserve the shift from doubt to resolve and keep the second thought complete.

2707.english: Well, that puts me in a tough spot. What am I supposed to do now...?
2707.localization_note: Keep the question together and preserve the hesitation at the end.
